newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Van Leer's financial manager resigns.
newsitem.headline: Van Leer's financial manager resigns.

text.p: Royal Packaging Industries Van Leer NV said on Thursday that Andre Saint-Denis would resign as chief financial officer and member of its executive board.
Saint-Denis was involved in planning, preparing and implementing Van Leer's listing on the Amsterdam Stock Exchange.

"This major project has now been successfully concluded and Mr Saint-Denis feels that it is now an appropriate time, for personal and family reasons, to return to his home country, Canada," Van Leer said in a statement. The company was floated on the Amsterdam bourse in May 1996.
